description: This header file defines the Wraps interface and singleton class for wrapping system calls and functions, mainly used for mocking and testing purposes in a network management context.

classes.name: WrapsImpl
classes.description: Abstract class defining virtual methods for system-related functions used to facilitate mocking in tests.

classes.name: Wraps
classes.description: Singleton class providing static methods that delegate to an implementation of WrapsImpl, enabling controlled access to system functions.

methods.name: Wraps()
methods.description: Constructor for the Wraps singleton class.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation instance used by Wraps.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of Wraps.

methods.name: popen
methods.description: Opens a pipe to a process.

methods.name: pclose
methods.description: Closes a pipe opened by popen.

methods.name: getmntent
methods.description: Reads the next entry from the mount table.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Pipes executing a command with security considerations.

methods.name: readlink
methods.description: Reads the value of a symbolic link.
